name: Wurmple
flavour_text: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Silcoon
flavour_text: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

name: Beautifly
flavour_text: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

name: Cascoon
flavour_text: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Dustox
flavour_text: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

name: Lileep
flavour_text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

name: Cradily
flavour_text: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

name: Kricketot
flavour_text: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Kricketune
flavour_text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Combee
flavour_text: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

name: Karrablast
flavour_text: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

name: Shelmet
flavour_text: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

name: Accelgor
flavour_text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

name: Dhelmise
flavour_text: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

name: Pheromosa
flavour_text: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

name: Poltchageist
flavour_text: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

name: Sinistcha
flavour_text: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home’s floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

name: Teal MaskOgerpon
flavour_text: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

name: Ponyta
flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Rapidash
flavour_text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

name: Flareon
flavour_text: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Moltres
flavour_text: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Cyndaquil
flavour_text: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

name: Quilava
flavour_text: The fur covering this Pokémon’s body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

name: Houndour
flavour_text: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndoom
flavour_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Heatmor
flavour_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Psyduck
flavour_text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

name: Golduck
flavour_text: It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow- moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

name: Staryu
flavour_text: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

name: Starmie
flavour_text: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

name: Carvanha
flavour_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Wailmer
flavour_text: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

name: Spheal
flavour_text: As it drifts among the waves, Spheal probes the sea. As soon as it spots prey, it informs the Walrein in its herd.

name: Sealeo
flavour_text: This Pokémon has a habit of spinning round things on its nose, whether those things are Poké Balls or Spheal.

name: Walrein
flavour_text: Walrein’s tusks keep growing throughout its life. Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their usual impressive size in a year.

name: Kyogre
flavour_text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Oshawott
flavour_text: It’s said that Oshawott learned to maintain its scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking humans it saw using whetstones.

name: Dewott
flavour_text: Dewott has a studious and stern personality. It masters the use of its scalchops through dedicated, repeated training.

name: Samurott
flavour_text: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

name: Alomomola
flavour_text: They float upon the open sea. Many water Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.

name: Dewpider
flavour_text: It supports the water bubble that envelops its head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.

name: Araquanid
flavour_text: It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles will get torn apart by Araquanid’s gnashing jaws.

name: Bruxish
flavour_text: When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly.

name: Pikachu
flavour_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

name: Shinx
flavour_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavour_text: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

name: Luxray
flavour_text: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

name: Pachirisu
flavour_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Tynamo
flavour_text: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

name: Eelektrik
flavour_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavour_text: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

name: Thundurus
flavour_text: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

name: Helioptile
flavour_text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

name: Heliolisk
flavour_text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

name: Wattrel
flavour_text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Kilowattrel
flavour_text: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

name: Clefairy
flavour_text: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

name: Clefable
flavour_text: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

name: Drowzee
flavour_text: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

name: Hypno
flavour_text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

name: Mime Jr.
flavour_text: It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps like an apprentice.

name: Mr. Mime
flavour_text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Mewtwo
flavour_text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

name: Ralts
flavour_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
flavour_text: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

name: Chimecho
flavour_text: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

name: Wynaut
flavour_text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

name: Woobat
flavour_text: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Swoobat
flavour_text: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Hoopa
flavour_text: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Oricorio
flavour_text: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

name: Makuhita
flavour_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavour_text: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Anorith
flavour_text: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

name: Armaldo
flavour_text: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

name: Groudon
flavour_text: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

name: Drilbur
flavour_text: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavour_text: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

name: Timburr
flavour_text: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
flavour_text: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
flavour_text: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.

name: Minior
flavour_text: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

name: Grimer
flavour_text: When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

name: Muk
flavour_text: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

name: Poochyena
flavour_text: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

name: Mightyena
flavour_text: Once it’s caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack moves out.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavour_text: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavour_text: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavour_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Gulpin
flavour_text: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

name: Swalot
flavour_text: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

name: Absol
flavour_text: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

name: Vullaby
flavour_text: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

name: Mandibuzz
flavour_text: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

name: Skarmory
flavour_text: Since the feathers that it sheds are thin and sharp, people apparently once used them as swords.

name: Mawile
flavour_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Beldum
flavour_text: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.

name: Metang
flavour_text: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

name: Metagross
flavour_text: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then Metagross uses the mouth on its stomach to chew its prey to bits.

name: Escavalier
flavour_text: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Genesect
flavour_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Duraludon
flavour_text: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

name: Archaludon
flavour_text: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

name: Varoom
flavour_text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

name: Revavroom
flavour_text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

name: Dratini
flavour_text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

name: Dragonair
flavour_text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

name: Dragonite
flavour_text: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

name: Rayquaza
flavour_text: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Noibat
flavour_text: Noibat can change the frequency of its sound waves at will, and it generates ultrasonic waves of up to 200,000 hertz.

name: Noivern
flavour_text: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

name: Turtonator
flavour_text: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

name: Drampa
flavour_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Applin
flavour_text: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

name: Dipplin
flavour_text: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

name: Hydrapple
flavour_text: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

name: Cyclizar
flavour_text: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

name: Rattata
flavour_text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

name: Raticate
flavour_text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

name: Eevee
flavour_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

name: Aipom
flavour_text: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

name: Ambipom
flavour_text: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

name: Skitty
flavour_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavour_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Kecleon
flavour_text: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its belly pattern disappear, however.

name: Pidove
flavour_text: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

name: Tranquill
flavour_text: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

name: Unfezant
flavour_text: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

name: Ducklett
flavour_text: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

name: Furfrou
flavour_text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

name: Type: Null
flavour_text: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

name: Silvally
flavour_text: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

name: Wurmple
flavour_text: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Lileep
flavour_text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

name: Kricketune
flavour_text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

flavour_text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

flavour_text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

name: Aipom
flavour_text: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

name: Alolan Vulpix
flavour_text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

name: Mudkip
flavour_text: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

name: Marshtomp
flavour_text: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

name: Swampert
flavour_text: Swampert’s arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down Swampert’s foes. This Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

name: Electabuzz
flavour_text: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

name: Plusle
flavour_text: This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its body to create noises.

name: Minun
flavour_text: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

name: Mr. Mime
flavour_text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Mewtwo
flavour_text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

name: Roggenrola
flavour_text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

name: Boldore
flavour_text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

name: Falinks
flavour_text: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

name: Koffing
flavour_text: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

name: Weezing
flavour_text: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavour_text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavour_text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

name: Rattata
flavour_text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

name: Raticate
flavour_text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

name: Smeargle
flavour_text: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from the tip of the tail is predetermined for each Smeargle.

name: Buneary
flavour_text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.

name: Raichu
flavour_text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.
